report.summary: Reviewed chunk 2 of providers/__init__.py: defines get_provider, list_providers, _configured, _availability_probe, provider_health, available_providers. No docstrings with claims; comments are internal.

handoff.purpose: Defines provider lookup, health check, and availability functions.

symbols.name: get_provider
symbols.note: Returns provider instance by string name; raises ValueError if unknown.

symbols.name: list_providers
symbols.note: Returns list of provider metadata dicts from _PROVIDERS.

symbols.name: _configured
symbols.note: Checks if provider is configured based on env keys; returns True if no key required.

symbols.name: _availability_probe
symbols.note: Probes provider availability; returns (bool, error_string). Handles unimplemented providers.

symbols.name: provider_health
symbols.note: Returns list of dicts with provider metadata plus configured/available/error fields.

symbols.name: available_providers
symbols.note: Returns dict mapping provider name to bool availability for implemented providers.

observations.what: Function get_provider is defined here but its definition is split across chunks; this chunk contains only the tail (lines 121-125).

Function available_providers has a docstring claiming it checks 'env keys / local server', but this chunk does not contain code that checks local servers; it delegates to provider_health and _availability_probe which may call get_provider().available().
